what_i_found: Yacht jousting where the storm is the weapon and both captains race for it in the same five seconds: a lance carried upright is the tallest thing on the sea, so sailing under a storm cell as it strikes charges it, while couching too early there gets your mast struck instead. Travelling crests launch a fast yacht so it strikes from above, but an airborne yacht cannot steer and the rival can slip out of reach.
